video.title: Buttonwillow 2026 Lemons, My best lap of the weekend
video.date: 24 Hours of Lemons Button Turrible, 26-27 Sep 2026 (uploaded 29 Sep 2026)
video.camera: Garmin Catalyst hood camera, ~1.05 m above the road (camh from the pit-wall Jersey, t004); Catalyst overlay with lap time, speed and a GPS minimap
video.stepped: every 2.0 s from 0:00 to 2:38 (80 frames; headless_capture.ts, 720p-1080p source); lap 21 runs from 0:05.47 to 2:32.95 (Catalyst lap timer 0:00.51 at 0:06, lap 22 timer 0:01.05 at 2:34)

pit_video.title: Lemons 2026 at Buttonwillow - Saturday - Jason Evening Yellow Flag Tour
pit_video.date: Saturday 26 Sep 2026, end of the race session (uploaded 13 Oct 2026)
pit_video.pit: 20:31 (1231 s) the car leaves the track left before T11 into the pit lane, 20:40-22:46 the lane end to end behind the pit wall to the starter's stand and the paddock (frames frames/pit_ucm/t<ms>.jpg every 9 s)

anchors.name: S/F
